summary: Global stocks climbed to a record as investors renewed bets on the artificial intelligence trade, driving gains in chipmakers. Oil and the dollar fell on the prospect of an interim US-Iran deal.

title: Mitsubishi UBE Cement Is Said to Plan for December Tokyo Listing
summary: Mitsubishi UBE Cement Corp. is planning to go public as soon as December, according to people familiar with the matter, five years after being formed through units of Japanese materials companies.

title: Rhodium: China Leads US in Key Tech Stack Areas
summary: A Rhodium Group analysis shows China leads the US and other G7 nations in several key areas of AI development, despite lagging behind in chips. Reva Goujon, a director at the group and co-author of the report, discusses the findings on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Gold Jumps With Silver as Markets Track Push to Reopen Hormuz
summary: Gold gained for a third day, as the prospect of an interim deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz eased concerns about the outlook for inflation and reduced the odds of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates.

title: China’s AI Agent Unicorn Lovart Is Said to Explore Hong Kong IPO
summary: Evoken, the Chinese startup behind AI design agent Lovart, is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, people familiar with the matter said, the latest such firm seeking to tap booming investor demand for artificial intelligence tools after the breakout success of Manus.

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 5
summary: Oil fell for a third day on optimism a deal can be reached to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, potentially freeing up Persian Gulf supplies.

title: SK Hynix Climbs as Investors Bet on Shareholder Return Plan
summary: Shares of SK Hynix Inc. advanced, lifted by an overnight rally in US chipmakers and speculation that the Korean firm may soon unveil buybacks and other details of a broader shareholder return plan.

title: LIC’s Big Share Sale Draws Investors Even as India’s IPO Market Stalls
summary: India expands the size of the offering to raise $3.3 billion amid strong demand.

title: Manipal Health Set for Muted Mumbai Debut After $960 Million IPO
summary: Manipal Health Enterprises Ltd. is set for a muted stock market debut in Mumbai after its $960 million initial public offering, as gray market trading signals cooling investor sentiment.

title: Australian Stocks Hit Record High on Iran Hopes, Economic Bets
summary: Australia’s stock benchmark briefly climbed to an intraday record on easing concerns over the US-Iran conflict and supportive signals in the domestic economy.

title: A Quant and a Korean Dentist Push the Limits of Leveraged ETFs
summary: A growing number of investors from the US to South Korea are using leveraged exchange-traded funds for long-term investing, a far cry from the day trading they were designed for.

title: Goldman-Backed Biotech Attovia Raises $289 Million in US IPO
summary: Attovia Therapeutics Inc., an early-stage drug developer focused on immune system diseases with high unmet need, raised $289 million in a US initial public offering that priced at the top of its marketed range.

title: Shionogi Eyes More US Plants, M&A Deals
summary: Isao Teshirogi, President and CEO of Shionogi & Co said the company is eyeing more manufacturing sites in the US for next decade. 'We’re actively pursuing minimum three deals today', he shared in an exclusive conversation with Bloomberg's Lisa Du. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s Quant Curbs Sap Volatility and Turnover: Equity Insight
summary: China’s latest initiative to rein in quantitative trading is proving something of a double-edged sword for the stock market as it has reduced volatility, but also sapped turnover.

title: SpaceX exceeds revenue estimates in first earnings report since IPO
summary: SpaceX’s revenue exceeded Wall Street’s expectations in the company’s first quarterly financial report following its blockbuster IPO in June. Ed Ludlow has the info on Elon Musk's rocket, satellite and AI conglomerate. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Compass Shares Jump on Cost Savings, Transaction Growth
summary: Compass Inc. shares jumped as much as 15% in post-market trading after the real estate services firm said cost savings from the acquisition of competitor Anywhere were progressing ahead of schedule.

title: Booking Holdings Keeps Full-Year Outlook on Resilient Travel
summary: Booking Holdings Inc. maintained its full-year outlook for gross bookings and revenue due to resilient travel demand even as the Middle East conflict weighs on flight prices and capacity.

title: Whale Rock Sank 22% as AI Selloff Crippled Hedge Fund Returns
summary: Whale Rock Capital Management’s flagship hedge fund is one of the biggest losers in last month’s AI selloff, with a 21.7% drop in July erasing about half of its gains for the year.
